text_block_list.text:
One day, I spot Токай Тэйо and Mejiro
McQueen
skulking in the shade of a
tree.

Hehehe! Let's watch them for a little
longer. It
looks like they're talking about
our best qualities!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Mortifying. I can't believe that we're

eavesdropping... Just a moment longer.

Understood?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: I follow their gaze to find...
Are you even listening? I'm telling you Teio's final sprint is way cooler!
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
McQueen is far more elegant and
graceful! The
way she carries herself is
just so radiant...
text_block_list.name: Сатоно Даймонд

text_block_list.text:
Easy there, you two! Arguing about
whether Teio
or McQueen's the better
runner again?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oh, Nature! And...
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
I have access to a great deal of
information
concerning the two in
question.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text: Me too! I know all about 'em too!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
...Aaand it looks like we've got all our
experts
here, so let's get into our
presentations!
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I heard this from Mayano, but she said
Teio
anonymously sent McQueen some
honey when
she wasn't feeling well.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
I have it on good authority that
McQueen
possesses a collection of all
race footage
featuring Teio. She uses it
to study Teio's racing
technique.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Wow! Oh, come to think of it, Teio did
spend a
whole day speaking like
McQueen so she could
understand her
better.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
There are also rumors suggesting
McQueen
attempted to sneak into the
student council
office as part of her
research into Teio.
text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus

text_block_list.text:
Okay, time for Turbo to talk! So
actually, the two
of them are—
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text: OKAAAY! That's enough!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
How dare you run your mouth with such

falsehoods! W-well, they may not all be

falsehoods, but still!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Ohoho? Hold on now, were you two

eavesdropping on us?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Uh-ohhh! Eavesdropperrrrs! ♪
Eavesdroppers on
the loooose! ♪
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Ugh! This is all your fault! You're the one
who
suggested listening in on their
conversation!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
What? You were the one who was all
enthusiastic
about it!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
You're always like this! Doing whatever
you
please and getting others involved
in your antics!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
I never forced you to do anything you
didn't want
to! If you've got a problem,
then let's settle things
right here, right
now!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, is this a fight? Or maybe a race?!
I wanna
race too if you guys are gonna!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. A race is in order if we are to
settle the
score!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
At least, it would be if we didn't have a
photo
shoot shortly after this...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Then how about something really
quick?! Liiike...
rock, paper, scissors!
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Rock, paper, scissors, eh? That's not
really...
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: Nah... That's not gonna cut it.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I must admit that I'm with you on
that.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: Huh? Why not?
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
Cause if I'm having a showdown with
McQueen, I
don't want to leave anything
to luck.
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I would also prefer to win against Teio
by my own
strength.
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Strength... Strength... Strength... How's
about
arm-wrestling, then?
text_block_list.name: Твин Турбо

text_block_list.text:
I guess I'm fine with that. It'd be a quick
way to
test our abilities against each
other!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
Now, now. We don't want to set a bad
example
for the younger students by
having such a childish
contest.
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: If only someone could help us settle this situ—
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
Oh! Perfect timing, Trainer! Could you
come and
mediate between these two?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер
choice_data_list:
If the battle's important, you should save it for
later.

text_block_list.text:
If the battle's important? Well, I
suppose you
have a point, but...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Wait, didn't you guys say that you have
a photo
shoot or something?
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text: Oh, the photo shoot!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Teio, we must hurry! We can still make it
if we run!
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text: R-right! Okay, see you all later!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text: And with that, the two run off together.

...Did you really sneak into the student
council
office?
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
I would never! Is it true that you
mimicked my
speech patterns?
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
They won't admit it, but they actually
get along
pretty well...
text_block_list.name: Найс Нэйчер

text_block_list.text:
All right! Now we can battle it out
without holding
anything back! Let's do
this!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
As the two of them have such similar
strength, the
ensuing battle drags on...
YOU TWO! You don't show up at the photo shoot, and when I come out looking for you, this is what you're doing?!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Эйр Грув?! The photo shoot... UH-OH!
text_block_list.name: Токай Тэйо

text_block_list.text:
How could this have happened? We
completely
forgot about it...
text_block_list.name: Мэдзиро МакКуин

text_block_list.text:
Save your remorse for later! The
president and
the others have been
waiting for too long
already! Let's go!
text_block_list.name: Эйр Грув

text_block_list.text: Ahaha, they sure do.
text_block_list.name: Китасан Блэк

text_block_list.text:
And with that, Токай Тэйо and Mejiro
McQueen
are dragged off to their photo
shoot...
